import importlib.metadata as md
m = md.metadata('tablegpt-agent')
print("### METADATA ###")
for k in ('Name','Version','Summary','Requires-Python','Home-page'):
    print(f"{k}: {m.get(k)}")
print("\nRequires-Dist:")
for r in (m.get_all('Requires-Dist') or []):
    print("  ", r)
print("\nDirect URL:")
print(open(md.distribution('tablegpt-agent').locate_file('tablegpt_agent-0.2.27.dist-info/direct_url.json')).read())
